product.title: Private Tour Kyoto-Nara w/Hotel Pick Up & Drop off from Kyoto

description.text: In Kyoto, this private six-to-ten-hour charter leaves a hotel lobby for a combined Kyoto and Nara day with an English-speaking driver-host and an air-conditioned vehicle. The published Nara window can include Todai-ji Temple, Nara Park, and Kasuga-Taisha Shrine, with Kinkaku-ji available on the Kyoto side of the same booking. Parking fees are listed; lunch and some admissions stay separate. Hotel pickup and drop-off are published from Kyoto so the group can stay with the two-city route rather than assembling express-train transfers. The format suits visitors who want a guided Kyoto-to-Nara day without self-driving. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Kinkaku-ji, Todai-ji, and Nara Park that define this outing rather than an Osaka castle add-on.

highlights: Private six-to-ten-hour Kyoto and Nara charter
Hotel pickup and drop-off from Kyoto
Published Nara stops such as Todai-ji
Lunch and some admissions listed separately

start.description: Meet in the hotel lobby in Kyoto. Contact details for pickup are listed on the booking ticket.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
